correctness.rationale: The normalized Laplace inner product is the exact Cauchy kernel 2sqrt(lambda_i lambda_j)/(lambda_i+lambda_j). Cauchy double-alternant gives the tanh product. For alpha<1, the kernel F_c(u)=-2 log tanh(cu/2) has integral pi^2/(2c) and the k-mesh near i has spacing alpha*i^(alpha-1); summing row terms yields N^(2-alpha)*pi^2/[2c*alpha*(2-alpha)]. Uniform tail truncation is supported by concavity and exponential decay. At alpha=1 the equal-index-gap sum gives gamma(c)N-beta(c)+o(1). For alpha>1 sum of off-diagonal sech entries is absolutely finite, G-I is trace class, injectivity from uniqueness of the Laplace transform of a finite atomic measure gives bounded invertibility and positive Fredholm determinant. Toeplitz positive symbol for alpha=1 and coherent large blocks for alpha<1 establish the frame/Bessel threshold. Inspected frozen RESULT.md and check.py; numerical diagnostics are finite checks, not proof of limits.
